items.summary: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today participated in the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Addressing the gathering on the occasion, the Prime Minister expressed happiness that Lucknow was chosen to host such a major skill development event, noting that as a Member of Parliament from Uttar Pradesh, it is a matter of pride for him as well.
items.title: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi participates in the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh
